text: During prints the filament suddenly stops feeding, sometimes after 5 minutes, sometimes after 5 hours. The filament end comes out swollen, like it melted and cooled inside the hotend. The hotend temperature looks normal.
The hotend temperature reading spikes up and down by a lot for a moment, then comes back. The heater itself seems fine.
Every print is under-extruded, but only on the front side of the bed. There the extruder clicks and skips; at the back it prints fine.
My new prints look under-extruded: thin layers with gaps. I recently set up the configuration.
The printer randomly freezes in the middle of a print. Klipper and the Raspberry Pi stop responding and the print halts.
Klipper keeps shutting down with heater errors during prints. Sometimes the hotend temperature drops suddenly.
When a print starts the nozzle is about 5 mm above the bed, even after I calibrated the Z endstop.
My print splits at a certain height: some layers come out thin and weak, then it continues.
I get layer shifts in X and Y after I replaced the belts.
There is a strange scraping noise when the toolhead moves, and the belt does not run straight at one drive.
The belt moves up and rubs at the B drive corner while the head moves.
Klipper randomly shuts down mid-print with 'Heater extruder not heating at expected rate'.
My prints have a regular wobble in the layer height, a repeating wave on the walls.
When the bed moves down there is a loud groaning noise from the back of the printer.
During prints Klipper stops with 'Lost communication with MCU' for the toolhead board.
When homing X or Y the toolhead reaches the end but sometimes jumps once sideways before stopping; worse at higher acceleration.
Prints stop at random heights with a 'move out of range' error.
Klipper refuses to start; error says a pin is reserved for SPI.
Long prints fail halfway with 'lost communication with mcu'; short prints are fine; only power cycling recovers.
First layer good at the front but clearly too high at the back, even after bed mesh.
Cold printer shows hotend about 15 degrees above room temperature.
Loud knocking noise each time the toolhead changes direction; prints look fine.
Both part cooling fans turn a few times, stop, and repeat; hotend fan is fine.
After restart the printer treats wherever the toolhead is as the home position.
First layer has a band of bad squish along X near the front; alternate lines differ in height.
Hotend temperature graph shows sudden spikes and dips; prints sometimes stop with temperature errors.
Horizontal bands on only one face of a test cube; follows printer orientation.
Neither controller board starts (no green LEDs) unless reset buttons are pressed.
None of the toolhead fans spin, although continuity is fine and the MCU fan works.
Every print looks thin and weak; walls have gaps; top layers not closed.
Printer stops shortly after heating starts with 'ADC out of range' for the hotend.
Hotend heats very slowly then printer stops with 'heater not heating at expected rate'.
Bed temperature reads a nonsense value and Klipper shuts down when the bed is turned on.
Bed never warms up; prints come loose; bed temperature stays at room temperature.
First layer is laid down from too high and does not stick anywhere on the bed.
First layer height changes from print to print without any setting change.
Layers shift diagonally partway through prints; parts measure wrong in one diagonal.
Random layer shifts in one direction, more at high speed; clicking near a motor.
Layer shifts only on fast moves or high acceleration.
Overhangs droop and bridges sag; small details melt.
Printing starts fine, then after some minutes extrusion stops and the extruder clicks.
Lines are thin and patchy across all prints; filament comes out curling.
Under-extrusion starts after the enclosure gets warm; filament shows little bite marks.
When loading filament the extruder pulls it back out instead of feeding it in.
On homing Z the bed moves the wrong way and grinds at the end.
First layer squished on one side and too thin on the other.
Regular horizontal lines on all walls at the same height spacing.
Klipper will not start after a fresh setup; config error about the extruder sensor.
Hotend temperature swings up and down by several degrees during prints.
Ghost echoes next to sharp corners and letters.
Trying to load filament, the extruder refuses to move and shows an error.
Printing ABS at 260 C fails; printer shuts down saying the extruder is above its maximum.
On homing X the toolhead hits the end and keeps grinding without stopping.
Stringing and occasional jams; molten plastic leaks near the top of the hotend.
Hotend fan, part fan and temperature all cut out at the same time, intermittently.
Prints pause by themselves even though filament is still loaded.
Popping sounds while printing, rough surface and lots of stringing with a new spool.
During fast travel moves the print pauses by itself at random points, although filament is still loaded.
Strong ghosting on prints that input shaping cannot remove; the Y resonance chart shows a large spike that looks like it belongs to X.
Sometimes when the hotend starts heating the whole power supply switches off and the printer restarts.
After about 100 hours, toolhead functions drop out at random: the hotend temperature reading jumps and the hotend fan stops when the head moves.
Layer shifts appear late in the print, and the X/Y motors are very hot to the touch.
When homing or jogging one axis the other axis also moves; prints come out skewed and the head crashes into the frame.
X shows strong ringing and a much worse resonance result than Y.
On the first heat-up the extruder jams and the hotend mounting adapter has melted.
Z homes once, moves away from the switch, then makes a loud ratcheting noise and will not move further; it grinds after a few millimetres.
Print stopped mid-way; afterwards the extruder makes a loud rattle and the gears only twitch back and forth instead of turning.
Z homing fails with 'endstop z still triggered after retract'; the motor sounds like it is turning but the bed does not move up off the switch.
At start-up X homing fails with 'No trigger on x after full movement' and the head keeps pushing into the rear right corner.
About two out of three prints stop with driver errors: extruder 'reset' and X or Y 'undervoltage' GSTAT messages, usually 30+ minutes into the print.
Prints fail with hotend 'temperature out of range' errors; the temperature graph shows sharp dips and spikes even after replacing heater and thermistor.
The extruder cannot grip the filament: filament slides through and gets no teeth marks even with full tension.
Input-shaper calibration does not work: the accelerometer on the umbilical board gives no usable measurement.
Prints keep stopping with 'Heater extruder not heating at expected rate'. I already replaced the whole extruder unit and it still happens.
The hotend heater randomly cuts out during prints and Klipper stops with 'heater extruder not heating at expected rate'.
Klipper shuts down with 'ADC out of range'. I changed the heater cartridge but nothing changed.
Since I replaced the mainboard I get 'heater_bed not heating at expected rate' and the bed stays cold.
My new build under-extrudes; walls are thin and have gaps even after calibrating.
Since I added bed mesh the nozzle digs into the bed at the start of the print, and in the wrong place.
There is a strange vibration and buzzing noise on Y moves, and the extrusion looks bad too.
When I push the gantry by hand along Y it feels tight and catches in places.
The temperature readings are wrong, the hotend shows a value far from the real temperature even when cold.
